claim: A thing keeps its own palette; it takes its sector's palette only in a fogged place. A town census that records the sector's palette on every sprite (DWE3M1 is fogged: 970 sprites of palette 1, every one in a palette-1 sector) teaches the wrong colours.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-18: 'objects should have different palettes if they are not in foggy place.' Said to the agent in conversation; not quoted in the repository. projects/blood-city/tests/test_city_second_walk.py:66-71 holds the rule (tiles 517, 758, 741, 802 at palette 0); tools/mine_city_assets.py:101-109 drops a sprite's palette when it equals its sector's.
DWE3M1, recounted 2026-11-26: 970 sprites of palette 1, all in floor_pal 1 sectors (924 of them decoration by mine_city_assets.is_decoration)
use: Mine a thing's own palette only (tools/mine_city_assets.py).
